Thanks — we can support the SOC 2 evidence exchange and propose the following:

2) Logs: we can produce a 72-hour telemetry snapshot and make it available via time-limited S3 presigned URLs. We typically provide a 48-96 hour window depending on retention configuration — 72 hours is fine.

4) Access window: propose Dec 4, 13:00–15:00 PT for a read-only handoff with auditors. If that doesn't work for you, suggest 2 alternate 1-hour windows.

I'll loop in Marissa from Security Ops to attach the runbook and provide the signed evidence list. We will redact customer PII by default and provide a redaction log. If EverGuard needs raw, unredacted data for forensics we can do a controlled access process — please confirm scope.
